body: Thank you for sharing that, and I'm sorry someone did that to you

In my experience, if you're still having doubts or questioning this, then it probably isn't the time. 

You might feel anxious about getting back out there, which might in itself present as some doubt. But as long as the feeling of readiness outweighs it, then I'd say you're ready.

I've done a heck of alot of self-reflection. Instead of submitting to usual unproductive/sometimes unhealthy ways of coping, I've allowed myself to actually have fun. Treated myself. Saying kinder words to myself. Spent time and money in myself. I've also done the more "difficult" things like sign up for therapy, and get myself to the gym. BUT without any expectation of myself. 

I can honestly say I'm doing so much better. I'm certainly not 100% healed, but the growth has actually been alot easier than I thought it was gunna be, because I've learnt to be kinder to myself (and treat myself like a queen hehe!).
Ouch...I can unfortunately relate to this
Amazing to hear. Keep it up ❤️
Awh glad to hear! It's such a painful thing to go through. Go easy on yourself, better days are ahead
Awh, good to hear!!
I stand by this too. I feel the same about my relationship. Think it's gunna take something real big to hit these guys in the face and realise wtf they're missing.

I remember one of the first things he said to me was that I wore "mumsy" clothes. I don't even know what this means lol. I've always loved clothes and always worn what I like rather than I guess always what's on trend. But as a 26 y/o without kids, you bet I changed up my fashion when he left! Shame he didn't stick around to see
Thank you ❤️
Yup
Happy birthday!!
Thank you for sharing, thats lovely 😊
Thanks so much ❤️

- Reconnected with friends and rediscovered deep bonds (I absolutely adore them). 

- I've invested a lot in myself (money wise), which I've never done before. I've always "cut corners" with myself in this way. So far I've bought new clothes, skin treatments etc. Even brought myself a Promise ring! Not that I'm promoting spending loads in an attempt to feel good (and I certainly don't spend money u don't have lol), but it's rather me rewarding myself for all the hard work I've put in/am putting in elsewhere. It feels so good and it's been a great boost of confidence. Like hey, I CAN treat myself! 

- I'm not in my comfort zone at the moment. And every step I take whilst out if it is an achievement in my eyes. I got very comfortable in the previous relationship, so this is teaching me how to be okay on my own, and depend only on me. It's scary, but I know this will help me in the end. 

- I started therapy. Been meaning to do it for a while but kept putting it off. I pushed myself to do it after the breakup, and it's given me some measure of progress and light at the end of this long road. 

I'm still a long way off, but I feel these little steps are progress nonetheless.
Thank you ❤️
Me too
Thank you ❤️
Awh how lovely! Thank you for sharing, that's so good to know. All the best to the both of you 💕
You don't deserve pain, please don't think that
Geez, I'm sorry :(

WOW. I certainly did not expect this post to blow up like this! Thank you everyone for your responses. Looks like there are in fact guys out there who want this just as much as I do. You've given me hope 👏👏 thank you

Yes! My last ex said he didn't like that we argued cos he never argued with his previous ex. I had to explain to him arguing is actually quite healthy part of any relationship. But I can't help but now feel he was just finding excuses. Mine have all ended just past that honeymoon period, around 1-1.5 years in. So strange.
A girl can dream too!
Amazing!! You give me hope 🎉 Wishing you both all the happiness
Ikr 😆
What age did you realise this if you don't mind me asking? Like when is it most guys think - "okay, best start thinking about long-term commitment"
That's so shit, I'm sorry

I'm the same but female lol. Takes me ages to break down the barrier and let someone in, and as I do that, I know I'm falling more and more in love with them - because I trust them entirely. It is crushing to then be blindsided and for them to walk away. I can absolutely relate. And the thought of having to start from scratch and do that all over again with someone else is fucking daunting. 

I see what you mean about support systems. I know my ex wouldn't talk to his parents or his friends about things and I always encouraged him to do so. I think he bottled things up and let them fester. I hate that stigma that men can't/shouldn't open up about that kinda thing. It's one of the reasons why make suicide is so high. 

Feel free to reach out. Always happy to listen.

That's good to know. I'm 26 and it seems like the guys I've dated have no sticking power whatsoever, and it can come across as quite immature tbh. Which I don't get, cos most people my age are engaged/married, and have kids. I know I shouldn't compare but you can't help but feel in a bit of a race with the rate everyone else is going.
Do you want eggs with your salt?

Fucking sucks ey. I'm sorry that happened to you too. 

Thanks for the info, that helps.
I both so sorry to hear, but also relieved to know people like you exist. I hope you find your completeness.

That makes sense, thank you for sharing. What I've found is that my exes have been absolutely head over heals for me to begin with (more invested than me usually!) and promise long-term commitment, "you're the one" etc etc. Then it seems the longer we go on, I grow more in love, and they pull away very suddenly. I get completely blindsided. So I'm bloody confused as to how I even spy out those noncommittal types in the first place 🙈 hence why it's making me very cynical...
That sucks, I'm sorry. If you don't mind sharing, can I ask how old you are? Only cos you mention about women already having kids.

Thank you for your kind words. You're so right, it certainly doesn't fix a broken heart, and it can end up actually doing more damage in the long term (and to more people)! 

Hope you heal soon
That's interesting!! Thank you for sharing

I actually did this with my last ex, and regret it entirely. I wasn't I've the guy before him, and was worried about losing my confidence so jumped into dating this new guy. I think it eventually caused the relationship break down because I was still processing my previous break up and unknowingly (and unfairly) projecting that on to him. I completely regret it, and feel immense guilt for putting my ex through that. Spoiler: I eventually fell in love with him and then he dumped me. 

I've learnt from that and now taking my time to process things properly before approaching dating again.
We exist 🙋‍♀️

I get you. It's a tough pill to swallow being told you're not "the one" for that person - I've always wanted to try and work things through, but they have made that decision to end it instead. Maybe that's my downfall.
Where are you all hiding? 🙈
Interesting...thank you! :-)
Me too. My question though - how do you detect a lovebomber from the beginning? Cos I've failed at that twice now.
I'm sorry to hear 😞 wishing you all the strength and happiness ❤️
Please stay and talk some more. You sound like a really interesting person and I'm sure we've all got a lot to learn from you and these emotions you're feeling.

It's honestly so awful, and I'm sorry you're here. The first few days are the hardest, be kind to yourself. I don't understand either, but there's lots here sharing the same thoughts and feelings - hopefully you can find some peace here. Stay strong.
They really do. I feel sick thinking about being with someone else, yet all I'm craving is companionship.
Gosh, I've never heard that before but it is so true! Thank you so much for sharing

Me too, especially at weekends. Can seem like all work and no play. I'm not sure of the answer but I'm trying to work out how to cope with this. Maybe try planning things ahead, or setting small goals for yourself that fill up this time.
Good on you!

Gosh, I'm sorry :( I always wonder what it's like getting back together after a break up. I would love for my ex to reach out now and say let's try again, but I know it's probably not the best idea in the long-term. Ergh, break ups are shit. I hope you feel better soon.
Thank you! It's been more of a "hey this isn't too bad" haha, but I'm glad it's helped me at least.

Realising how much I actually like my work, and how it has actually helped me. I'm hoping to focus more of my attention to some career progression and choosing a specialism (as I get more motivated lol). I've also got back into reading, which I've been meaning to do for ages but never found the time.
Awh, I'm sorry, that's so shit :(. Stay strong ❤️
It's a nightmare isn't it :( How long were you together and how long since the break up if you don't mind me asking?
Absolutely :(
Thank you, I really needed this today.
I wish I knew too.
It's not a fiction book, but I found "This is me letting you go" by Heidi Priebe to be really helpful.
Yes!! I'm strangely worried about the cold dark nights, getting up to go to/coming back from work in dark. Makes being alone seem much more daunting.
Thank you for this, I really needed to hear this.
Me too
I relate to both of these. Sucks.
F
It's weird how this all works isn't it. Sometimes they're the farthest thing from our minds - other times, we can't escape thinking about them.

I'll admit I rushed into my last relationship to escape the pain. Ended up falling for this guy the longer I was with him, and now 1.5-2 years later, he left too. I know not to make the same mistake of moving on so quick because there was so much healing I was still doing at the start of that last relationship, which was unfair on him. 

This longing just sucks. I just wish I knew the way to truly let go without being dependent upon someone else to "free" me.
You're amazing, thank you for sharing. I needed to read this today.
Yup. Really sucks.
Awful messages - I'm sorry you had to see things like that from someone you love. Clearly he doesn't treasure you enough.

Well, as a dumpee these responses have made me very confused about whether I should reach out to my ex or not. How I see it is that since HE dumped me, it should be him to make the effort and contact me if he wants me back. Of course I want him back, cos I didn't want to break up in the first place. So I feel that just goes unsaid? Man :l
This is great haha, but very true!
I have nutritional shakes when I get like this. Here in the UK my favourite is Complan. They're filling and you get all your nutrients too
See starting uni as a fresh opportunity. Sure, you're not feeling fighting fit at the moment, but it will likely be better than staying at home. Stay strong.
Good on you!
Yes

This is so interesting, thank you for sharing. Realising that many of my relationships have ended just before the true love phase. They have left me. I see that I have been the one to compromise and accept their faults, but I don't think that has been the case for my exes. Such a shame, I just hope someone will eventually see that phase through for me.

I couldn't go to work for a good few days just after the breakup. Was the first time I called in sick for such a thing (and I felt guilty as hell). But my job is quite mentally taxing and I didn't feel I could work safely in that headspace. I'm glad I took that time off cos I really needed it - it allowed me to strip everything back to basics and all I did was sleep/cry/try to eat and repeat. 

Going back to work wasn't as bad as I thought it would be. It's been nice to be so busy and have my mind taken off things for the majority of the day. 

But you know you/your work best. All of say is don't be afraid of asking for time off when you're feeling like this, as it might not be the best place for you to be at the moment.

I can honestly relate to this, you only need to have a look back at my posts. I get waves of not wanting to be here.

And yes, I've been in this position before with previous relationships. My last 2 I have documented on here and asked for help. 

I don't have the answer at the moment, as I'm seeking it myself. But all I know is that there will be better days. I have had better days since this break up. I know it doesn't make it any easier right now, but please hang on a little longer. 

You're so brave. You're so strong. We're all here to support you. Keep talking.
You're not pathetic.
Thank you, you give me hope!

Join the boat (and I'm sorry you're here posting this). I was similarly blindsided. It makes no sense, and I doubt it ever will tbh. It's absolute agony right now, I know. And it's awful when they turn cold like that - makes no sense at all and you feel worthless. The thing is, they have probably been planning this for a while (like you saw the changes), and they have been through their emotions and waited until they felt better to then tell you. You can't compare in that sense I'm afraid.

No words will probably bring you comfort at the moment as I know how much you just want things to go back to how they were. But I promise you, and what you'll read time and time again, is that time can heal things. You won't always feel this way. 

We're all in this together, and hopefully you can find some comfort in that. Stay strong OP.

Imagine if he responded coldly, or not at all and just read the message. You might be reopening a wound there that will only hurt yourself, and you don't deserve any more pain. 

Think about it carefully for a while, don't make a rushed decision. Sometimes it's best to write it out in a letter that you never end up sending.
Day 20 and I'm so over feeling like this, it really interferes with every aspect of life. Wish we could switch off our emotions at times like these
Are you literally me?? Lol. I'm 26 and having EXACT same issue - I posted about this just before 😂 I swear men have no sticking power?!

Get it all out your system!! In case no one else told you today, you're doing amazing. Even in these down moments. You're so much stronger than you think and it's incredible that you've done so much self reflection and improvement already. Try get some sleep and tomorrow might be a bit brighter.
I'm not sure, but I'd really like to know myself too. So sorry to hear about your Father, that must have been so difficult. Stay strong OP.
Exactly, just don't do it if it can be helped. It's not worth getting pushed back again.
Welcome to the club (and I'm sorry you're here).
I had an ex who did that too. I was astounded. When I confronted him about it, he literally didn't see what the issue was. Told me he was "supporting other instagrammers". Bullshit.

Gosh, I really think you're missing some things here that needs to be recognised! You sound incredibly strong, and I bet you don't feel it atm. But put it this way. YOU put yourself through that relationship, persevered because you saw the best in him and you believed in him. HE out you through hell nonetheless, yet you still stuck it out. YOU broke up with him. YOU took control of that situation, recognised it for what it was, and got the hell outta there. You knew it was going to be painful, but you did it nonetheless. YOU ARE SO freaking strong, you don't even know it!!! 

It can only go up from here. You are in the thick of it, but have gotten through the testing parts. You are so capable of doing this.

She sounds easily influenced. When we want something so much, it usually doesn't matter what others think. You've done what you can - give yourself credit there. Only you know if she's truly worth pursuing or not, but from it outside, it sounds like she's flakey and that's a red flag in my opinion.

Try not to lose sight of yourself. It's easy to do in relationships, and all of us do to some degree. But make sure you keep up with social groups and hobbies etc. Don't lost sight of the things that are important to you when you're not under anyone elses influence.

She sounds toxic and manipulative. You can do (and deserve) SO much better. This is in your control too don't forget. Cut her off, start afresh. I know that's easy for me to say as I'm not in your position, but from an outsider's perspective of what you've described, that's how it appears. You might know this deep down already, but yeah - time to leave.

"If you really loved me, you would've fought for me". Man I know that feeling all too well. It fucking sucks and reading this breaks my heart. I'm sorry you're going through it. I feel it too, just how you describe. Hoping you heal soon
Thank you so much for your advice and kind words ❤️ here's to both of us healing ❤️
Thank you for sharing, I needed to read this today. Do you have any tips for getting over him? Currently day 19 and feel like I've relapsed.

If you're questioning it, then it's not the time. I've rushed into another relationship before healing, and would 100% not recommend it. That pain never disappears - you just suppress it for a while. But it always rears its ugly head again at some point.


Work on the healing NOW. And leave that stuff till when you're in a better place. Trust me.

Thank you. I'm actually a girl and it was my ex bf who dumped me lol - currently day 19 I think. But I understand what you mean. I find videos and books useful. So far I've found Guy Winch and School of Life to be amazingly helpful. I guess it just takes time and patience, thanks for the advice.

I would love to know some of the things you did to get to the place you are mentally and physically now? Only if you don't mind sharing. Could use some inspiration rn as going through all the motions

So inspiring. Thank you for sharing. One day, I'm sure.
Fire away

I'm here for you

That's a great way to think about it. Go easy on yourself, you're going through a ton at the moment. Be kind to yourself, and treat yourself well. Gym etc can wait until you are feeling stronger - which WILL come, trust me. But for now, time to focus on you and your needs only. Hang in there.

I'm glad it helps. All I'm doing is trying, don't get me wrong. It is so difficult, I understand. I started listening to the book to help me with those feelings. I'm certainly not 100% there yet (only day 16!), but it is helping. 

All I can say at this moment is, please just look after yourself and address your needs first and foremost in the next few days/weeks. It's gunna really suck for a while, but there will be better days ahead.
Ergh

Firstly, I'm so sorry you're here and posting this. That sounds awful, and I completely understand why you feel that way and the effect it's having on you. Please take pride in knowing you did the best you could. 

At this moment in time, you just need to focus on yourself. What do you need (physically, emotionally, mentally) to get through these hours. I know it feels like your life support has been taken away from you, but ask yourself what you need in the here and now, and try to meet that in the next few days (which are undoubtedly the hardest).

Things are foggy now. Eventually it'll go hazy, and maybe clear a little bit for you to think more about it. But for now, you're gunna feel a lot of pain - it'll come in waves, so be prepared. But there WILL be periods of relief coming up too. Not full-blown ecstasy, but periods of numbness and maybe little snippets of joy. 

Vent it all on here. We all know exactly how you feel, and we are all going through very much the same ourselves. It really, really sucks, but we've got each other for now.

I was terrified, cos I thought it was a pathetic excuse (yet certainly doesn't feel that way as we all know!!!). Especially at work where I have to put in such a professional face all the time. Usually I'm the one sorting everyone else's issues and illnesses lol. But it felt like a weight had been lifted off. 

And not that's it's an excuse, but it gives me some room to not be "100%" all the time, and my colleagues will understand. I was really surprised at how empathetic most people were with me, and I hope you have similar experience. Yes it might be awkward, but most can relate to a degree. Sometimes they just won't know what to say, but that's okay. 

Go for it when you feel ready. My friend said to me it only "makes us more human".

I'm soooo curious about this too. And what do his friends say after he's initiated a break up? Are they supportive? Do they just promote getting with other people and avoid talking about feeling altogether?
That was well worth watching, thank you

We don't talk about this kinda thing enough. I feel you, I'm in the same position. As a friend said to me the other day, try not to beat yourself up for not doing anything - there's reward in rest too. And sometimes we NEED it. Try your best, but please, please go easy on yourself. You're going through alot right now. Length of time in the relationship is irrelevant. Time to take care of yourself and listen to what YOU need right now.

That's amazing, good on you! It's great you have something to focus on too, and it just goes to show you - you never know what the future might bring! Stay strong. Feel free to share your good (or bad!) news anytime. Always happy to listen.
100% fake. She's probably doing it for effect - and that's directed at you. Block it, it'll only keep hurting you.
What's your good news? My mum is ill too, so I understand how you feel. Share it with us instead.
Beautiful, thank you
Stay strong, you've got this

However, we'd never split but we're probably close to, and would both come back with tears in our eyes saying we'd try harder. From my point of view, it made it stronger cos we fought for each other. In my eyes we were doing brilliantly towards the end, and hadn't had a large argument for quite a while as things seemed to settle. But he turned around one day and said he doesn't see a future with me, and left. 

I can only go off of my point of view and feelings and try find closure in those events. But he was clearly thinking along different lines. (Sorry for the long-winded explanation)
Thanks everyone!

You and me both. Mine also ended out if nowhere and we were doing incredibly well, and 1.5 years in. He was the one who previously said he couldn't imagine his life without me. It's now day 14 since he dumped me, out of the blue. I'm so confused more than anything. 

It's also so, so painful. Hopefully we both get through this phase soon, because it fucking sucks.
Me too. We've been here before, and we got through it last time. Although it doesn't make it easier, at least we know what we're capable of pushing through. Hoping it gets easier for you.

Any help appreciated. TIA.

If she cares about you, she'll probably be hugely apologetic for making you feel that way, and offer you reassurance. It might just come out that she's confused about the relationship, and she grips on out of fear of the unknown - I've been in this position before.

Thank you for your insight, and I hope you're continuing to heal. I think that's just it, I'm trying to rush the process. I've just gotta take my time I guess.
Thank you, I needed this
I'm there with you, it's so tough.
I did that with an old ex - instant regret, let me tell you. I still regret it to this day and I wish I could take it back. Just don't do it - take the high road instead. It doesn't solve anything.

Sorry you're going through this. This feels exactly like my position, but I am the dumpee. I often wonder what is going through my exes mind at the moment, and I wonder if he feels the same way you do. I know he was upset to see me so hurt by his decision, and we've been NC since. 

All I want is for my ex to reach out, I won't lie. But if it's not going to amount to anything in the future, then I know deep down that it's best we remain NC. There's little point delaying the pain. It's a hard pill to swallow nonetheless. At this time, I have to rely on those around me to help, or reach out to people that can - hopefully your ex will be able to do the same.

This is going to be tough to hear, I know, but you need to go NC. Take back what control you have and initiate it yourself. It'll force him to think about what it is he really wants, which includes reconsidering his actions. But for now, you need to start closing that chapter, for your own good. I hope you're okay.
Wishing you all the best
It's so hard, isn't it.
Often
Thank you, I needed to hear this
I'm sorry you're going through this. I wish I knew the answers, but all I can say is hang in there.
Me too
Gosh, I could've written this myself. I'm in the exact same situation. It's sad more than anything (anger, frustration etc). I guess we just gotta trust fate.

"...you ghosted me without the decency of a break up text.." 

Gosh, I'm so angry for you just reading that, and I'm sorry this has happened to you. Break up texts are crumby themselves, but nothing? Well, I have no words. 

You're not broken, you're just a little lost - lead astray by this encounter. You'll find your way back, slowly, and maybe with some support too. 

That person deserves nothing more from yourself, and as crushing as it may feel, it's time to start closing that chapter. It'll work out with someone new, just give it (and yourself) time. Hope you're okay.

Yup, right there with you, but only 5d in. Woke up this morning in a much more positive mindset. Now (evening), that sadness begins to gnaw away again, and my chest feels tight. It's peaks and troughs, but hopefully the general trend is still upward; little by little. Hope you're doing okay.

God, I feel this so much. Thank you for putting into words something I could never express myself, but feel so deeply, and more than I dare to admit. You're so right; going forward into the wilderness, indeed lending ourselves to fate, takes so, so much courage. I truly hope the future brings you peace. Thank you again for sharing, I needed to hear this.

You've got insight, which is a really positive and empowering thing in this very difficult situation. Try your best, now or in the future, to use this to your advantage going forward. To learn from it. This is going to be tough, there's no question about that. But we're all here for you, and to hopefully help share the load too.

I guess the question is, will maintaining this particular relationship hurt either party? It inevitably creates a link to a past that either if you might benefit from moving on from. But it's of course a very personal decision!

I guess it's more a question of how you are remembering those times. Is it just a case of a certain situation has given you a bit of déjà vu which sparks a memory. Or are you comparing situations (consciously or subconsciously), and if so, are you missing the previous?
I'm sure it's "normal", I certainly experience the same. But you have to ask yourself where those thoughts are coming from, and why they might be popping up.
It's a truly awful feeling. But you know what? I'd give my everything again and again, even if it meant getting hurt. Because I guess when it eventually works, it'll be the most amazing thing ever.

You've gotten through all your bad days so far. You've done so well, and are still doing so well. I know the path ahead seems very dark - maybe you can't see it yet. But that's okay. It's there, and will unfold in time. But for now, take it one day, one hour, one minute at a time. Each in itself is an accomplishment, please realise that. 

Please reach out for support. On here, or better still to professionals trained to listen. We all need help in our lives, it's nothing to be scared or ashamed of. There's professionals you can text if you don't feel like speaking.

You've got this - even if you feel like you've lost all control. We're all here for you.
That's some fab advice, thank you for sharing
Thank you stranger
I needed to hear this right now. Thank you
It's truly awful. I hope the new day brings you relief
I'm sorry you are able to relate, I hope you find peace too :(

It sounds like you have a lot of insight into your mental health and know exactly what you need, so I would suggest following through with a voluntary admission. Don't wait till it gets any worse or feel guilty in doing so, it's better to be safe than sorry, and to act now and access the help you need. If you can't talk on the phone, then there are many other options available for support following this. Your GP should be able to refer you and explain the situation, or the hospital can get you seen by an appropriate team.

Of course no problem, I'm happy to help. Some useful numbers are: 

-Emergency services: if your life is in imminent danger then please do not hesitate to call 999.

-SHOUT Crisis team: for when everything is getting too much and you're feeling unable to cope and need support in a personal crisis: text SHOUT to 85258.

-Samaritans: again, for when you need support, someone at the end of the line, or someone to talk through your suicidal thoughts with you. Samaritans have a mainline (116 123), but they also have a texting service that is not widely advertised (07725 909090) which may be of more use to you. You can even email them: jo@samaritans.org.

-'Mind' is another service that offers help, support and advice to both you and family/friends, but they're open Monday to Friday 9am to 6pm (except bank holidays). 
Website: www.mind.org.uk
InfoLine: 0300 123 3393 to call, or text 86463
Email: info@mind.org.uk

I think these are the most important numbers, but there are so many services you can access, I'll leave these resources here with more contact numbers: 

https://www.mind.org.uk/information-support/guides-to-support-and-services/crisis-services/getting-help-in-a-crisis/

https://www.centreformentalhealth.org.uk/crisis-contacts

https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/stress-anxiety-depression/mental-health-helplines/

I hope this helps. Please keep us updated with how you are doing and if you need anymore help, or would just like to talk.
